claims.object_text: increased expression during acute phase following TBI
claims.quote: the expression of KNa1.2 channel was notably increased only during the acute phase following TBI, while no significant elevation was observed during the late phase.

claims.object_text: enhanced KNa1.2 channel may be neuroprotective in acute TBI phase
